# Chart runtime

The standalone runtime is TradingView Lightweight Charts **5.2.1**, Apache-2.0,
from the official npm package:

https://registry.npmjs.org/lightweight-charts/-/lightweight-charts-5.2.1.tgz

The archive was checked against the npm registry's SHA-512 integrity value before
extracting the standalone production file and LICENSE:

`sha512-IVwoK1RLFiLPubaKIjNbtjWLnpPMqiABSrTay6whmNa8L1+19292VtHJ+BWyPUuLCwF0tcQlhEWd1CLB2a1nsQ==`

NOTICE is from the upstream `v5.2.1` tag. Keep the copyright and license headers,
LICENSE and NOTICE when updating. The report includes a visible TradingView link
and the library's attribution logo. It loads only local scripts and styles.

This standalone bundle includes fancy-canvas and tslib code. Their notices and
licenses are retained with this directory's third-party notices.
